name: flaglens

scripts.up: docker compose up -d && node -e "(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<60;i++){try{const r=await fetch('http://localhost:8000/health/liveness/');if(r.ok){console.log('Flagsmith ready at http://localhost:8000');process.exit(0)}}catch{}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000))}console.error('Timed out waiting for Flagsmith');process.exit(1)})()"

description: FlagLens: a VS Code extension for self-hosted Flagsmith
